description: Nyja, the dark god guarding the gates of the Slavic underworld, a tall majestic figure in long black and dark purple robes with silver trim, a pale stern face with a long dark beard, a crown of black iron spikes, a cold blue frost aura around him, holding a tall black staff with a pale moonstone, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the figure alone, no ground, no background, the whole figure and staff inside the picture
